title: Exploratory SCCI-2026 quantum-interface convention calculator
description:
This repository contains an exploratory calculator for the numerical consequence of an explicitly declared SCCI-2026 quantum-interface modelling convention. It evaluates the value of Delta_Phi implied by the convention 10^(-6 / Delta_Phi) = 1 / log10(105^49).

The repository includes a Python implementation, unit tests, documentation of definitions, assumptions, derivation, and limitations, and a machine-readable JSON report.

This work does not validate Google Willow, any 105-qubit processor, SCCI-2026, a hybrid quantum interface, unitarity, noise suppression, quantum gate fidelity, or any physical claim. The calculated value is a numerical consequence of the declared convention, not a validated physical constant or critical threshold.
